_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F09, Sir Wobbles again (comic; his king comes later).

text.zh_TW: 晃晃爵士又出現了，水桶被燻得漆黑。「平民！吾正在修行……修行被烤。」
text.en: Sir Wobbles again, his bucket black with soot. "Commoner! I am training... training at being toasted."

text.zh_TW: 晃晃爵士：「吾聽說吾王——偉大的史萊姆王，被收集者抓去了！若你見到他……請溫柔一點。他很怕癢。」
text.en: Sir Wobbles: "I hear my liege, the great Slime King, was taken by the Collectors! If you meet him... please be gentle. He is very ticklish."
